lines.text: Mark had a plan: dry socks at the summit.
He reached into the side pocket.
The spare socks were soaked through, along with his gloves.
Snow melting on the pack all morning.
Now his spares go into a dry bag, rolled shut three times, deep inside the pack.
At the top, dry socks, dry gloves, warm feet for the walk down.
Save this before your next winter hike.
